content.guideline_info: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation. Discusses catheter ablation, conduction system pacing, heart failure, ventricular remodeling, and genetic testing. Includes management considerations for athletes and patients with obesity.
focus_areas: Conduction system pacing vs conventional pacing
Role of genetic testing in early onset atrial fibrillation
management_strategies: Early catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation
Lifestyle modifications for atrial fibrillation management

genes.context: Goodyer WR, Dunn K, Caleshu C, et al. Broad genetic testing in a clinical setting uncovers a high prevalence of loss-of-function variants in very early onset atrial fibrillation.
